stops.note: 'broth, sauce'; Cicero punned on it against Verres, whose name meant 'boar': 'ius Verrinum' was both Verrine justice and boar gravy
juice or cooking liquid, still seen in 'au jus'
orange juice became an American breakfast staple through the California growers' 'Drink an Orange' campaign of 1916
